title: Don't Eat Your Seed Be Blessed
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner reveals a simple yet profound principle for living a life of financial freedom and generosity. By learning to release what God has given us, rather than hoarding it, we can experience a miraculous flow of blessings and abundance in every area of our lives. Join Pastor Chris as he shares a compelling analogy and shares the biblical truth that will transform your finances and your heart.
